DROPTASKv1.1

A task manager where urgency is visual. Tasks fall down the screen in real time — the closer the deadline, the faster they fall.

When a task hits the bottom, you missed it. The goal is to keep everything off the floor.

  • ↓Tasks fall at speeds proportional to their deadline
  • 🎨Color shifts from dark to bright green as urgency increases
  • ⚡Priority view surfaces anything within 40% of its deadline
  • ⚠Alerts fire at 30% time remaining
  • 📁Organize tasks into projects — Personal, Work, House, and more
